payload.blocks: Phase 3 land of plan 261125-2313 (refused land-regenerate-failed, os error 28), and every other land on this machine while the disk stays full.
payload.headline: Disk is full (3.4G free): discard the lead's two superseded worktrees p02 and p03 (about 21G)?

parts.cause: Worktrees of replaced attempts were never removed, and land-door candidate dirs were not cleaned. The supervisor may only remove worktrees delivered to main, and the unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is not reachable by message.

options.does: Run: fgos worktree remove --discard-ignored /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/261125-2313-head-communication-agent-to-agent-p03 ; fgos worktree remove --discard-ignored /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/261125-2313-head-communication-agent-to-agent-p02
options.harm: Loses uncommitted bytes in two superseded worktrees (lead says discard ok).
options.label: Discard p02 and p03 worktrees

options.does: The above, plus check that no land is running and remove the 5 stale dirs under .fgos/runtime/git-candidates.
options.harm: Removing a candidate of a land in progress would break that land; needs a check first.
options.label: Also clear git-candidates

options.harm: All lands on this machine keep failing.
options.label: Leave it

parts.recommendation: Discard p02 and p03 worktrees now; file the git-candidates leftovers as a separate backlog item for the land door.

scope.allows: Removing the two named worktrees of plan 261125-2313 only.
scope.forbids: Touching p02b, p03b, p01 or any other plan's worktree.

parts.what: The land of branch head-communication-agent-to-agent/p03b failed with no space left. The lead reports p03 (16G) and p02 (5.4G) as dirty, superseded by p03b and p02b, safe to discard. .fgos/runtime/git-candidates also holds 29G of land-door leftovers (5 dirs).
